tasks.goal:
REQUIREMENTS:
R1 POST /api/projects/<id>/clips/import_preview adds a top-level "errors" list to its JSON: one object per malformed row in file order with an integer "line", "reasons" (that row's reason strings) and "raw" (the row's original text as it appeared in the file, without its line ending); valid and duplicate rows never appear in it, and "rows" and "summary" are unchanged
R2 Under #import-preview-summary a table #import-preview-errors lists one <tr data-line="<line>"> per malformed row showing the line number and its reasons joined by "; ", in file order; the table carries the hidden attribute whenever the last preview had no malformed rows
R3 A link #import-preview-errors-download with download="import-errors.csv" points at a CSV of the last preview's malformed rows (header line,reason,raw; one row per malformed row with several reasons joined by "; "; values quoted by the CSV rules); it is hidden whenever the table is
R4 The existing tests under tests/ still pass and the preview flow (open a project, choose a CSV with malformed rows) logs no browser console errors

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 An input #project-search inside #project-list-screen, placed before #projects-container, filters the rendered .project-card elements as the user types: cards whose .name contains the query case-insensitively stay, the rest get the hidden attribute; no request goes to the server and the page does not reload
R2 A span #project-search-count reads "<shown> of <total> projects" while the query is non-empty and is empty otherwise; a button #btn-project-search-clear empties the query, shows every card and empties the count
R3 The query is mirrored into location.hash as "#q=<URL-encoded query>" and the hash is removed when the query is empty; loading the page with such a hash fills the input and applies the filter
R4 When no card matches a non-empty query, #project-search-empty is shown with a one-line message; it is hidden whenever at least one card matches or the query is empty
R5 The existing tests under tests/ still pass and the project list with a search in progress logs no browser console errors

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 PATCH /api/projects/<id> with JSON {"name": ...} trims the name and returns 200 with the full updated project; it returns 400 with a JSON "error" naming the rule when the trimmed name is empty, longer than 80 characters, or equal case-insensitively to another project's name (a project may keep its own name); an unknown id returns 404
R2 The new name is persisted through _save_projects: a fresh _load_projects() and GET /api/projects both show it, and no .projects-*.tmp file is left beside projects.json
R3 Each .project-card has a button .rename-btn; clicking it shows an input .rename-input prefilled with the name; Enter sends the PATCH and updates the card's .name without a reload; Escape restores the card unchanged and sends nothing; a 400 shows the server's "error" text in an element .rename-error inside the card and leaves the name unchanged
R4 Renaming changes nothing but "name": id, video_filename, tag_types, players, clips (with their recordings) and filter_presets are identical before and after
R5 The existing tests under tests/ still pass and the rename flow logs no browser console errors

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 GET /api/projects/<id>/export/manifest.csv returns 200 text/csv whose header is exactly "Clip ID,Tag Type,Start (s),End (s),Label,Notes,Players" with one row per clip in the project's clip order; an unknown id returns 404 JSON
R2 GET /api/export/manifest.csv returns every project's clips with a leading "Project" column (the project name) before the same columns, projects in list order
R3 Values containing commas, quotes or newlines are quoted so the csv module reads back the original text; Players uses the import preview's form: "#<number> <name>" per player (bare "<name>" when the player has no number), joined by "; "
R4 Both responses carry Content-Disposition: attachment with filename "<project name with spaces as _>_manifest.csv" ("all_projects_manifest.csv" for the global export), and each .project-card has an anchor .export-manifest whose href is that project's export URL
R5 Round trip: uploading a project's export to the import preview of a project with the same tag types and players and no clips yields summary.malformed 0 and summary.valid equal to the exported clip count
R6 The existing tests under tests/ still pass

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 With no projects, #projects-container holds a panel #projects-empty with a one-line explanation and a button #btn-projects-empty-create that moves focus to #new-project-name; the old inline "No projects yet" paragraph is gone
R2 Creating the first project through the form hides the panel (hidden attribute) and shows its card without a reload
R3 Deleting the last project through its card shows the panel again without a reload
R4 The existing tests under tests/ still pass and both transitions log no browser console errors

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 GET /videos/<name> and GET /recordings/<name> resolve the requested name against VIDEOS_DIR or RECORDINGS_DIR and refuse any request whose real path is outside that directory or passes through a symlink with status 403 and the JSON body {"error": "denied"}
R2 The refused shapes include a ".." segment (../projects.json), the same with URL-encoded dots (%2e%2e/projects.json), a nested one (sub/../../projects.json), a symlink inside the directory whose target lies outside it, and a symlinked directory; the route must accept names containing "/" so the guard, not routing, answers them
R3 Every refusal is logged exactly once through app.logger at WARNING level with the client address and the word "denied", and the message never contains the requested name
R4 A regular file inside the directory is served unchanged with status 200 and its bytes; a missing regular name still returns 404
R5 The existing tests under tests/ still pass

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 _save_projects writes projects.json as {"schema_version": 1, "projects": {<id>: <project>, ...}} and _load_projects returns the projects mapping alone
R2 A legacy file holding the bare projects mapping is loaded with every project, tag type, player, clip and recording reference preserved exactly and rewritten once in the versioned shape on that first load; a second load rewrites nothing
R3 Before that rewrite the legacy file's bytes are copied to projects.json.bak-<UTC timestamp YYYYmmddTHHMMSSZ> in the same directory
R4 The rewrite is atomic: if os.replace fails mid-write, projects.json still holds the legacy bytes and no partial or temporary file is left
R5 A file whose schema_version is greater than 1 makes _load_projects raise an error naming both versions, and GET /api/projects answers 500 with a JSON "error" naming both
R6 The existing tests under tests/ still pass
